summary: Allocation helper (__thiscall). Allocates a heap block of 432 multiplied by 32 bytes when a2 is nonzero, or 432 multiplied by 8 bytes when a2 is zero, via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, stores the returned pointer into this[0], and returns this.

operations.description: Guard on a2 selecting 32 or 8 as the element count factor.
Call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with the computed byte count to allocate the block.
Store the allocation result into this[0] (field this+0x0).
Return this, allowing the call to be chained.
Called by CollisionObjectInsertion (0x004B48E0), which uses this helper to allocate storage sized by the a2 flag.

unresolved: Element size 432 and the meaning of the two counts (32 vs 8) selected by a2 are unknown.
Packet prelabel flags this as a structural twin of SimpleSetterWithSubCall via cluster_copy, but the owning class and field-0 slot purpose are still unknown.
